description: Festpunktübersicht ohne Festpunktbeschreibung (BVV) - Web Map Service is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.bayern.de. The location and height points of the BVV are permanently installed (marketing) stable survey points distributed across the country. The maximum viewable image is 2000 x 2000 pixels. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Fixed point overview without fixed point description (BVV) — Web Map Service" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Lagefestpunkt, Festpunktübersicht, AdVMIS, Trigonometrische Punkte, Bayerische Vermessungsverwaltung, gdiby. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2019-08-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
